currentManifest.title: 会議、聞いてます？ ～MEETING SURVIVAL～
currentManifest.subtitle: 進捗は出したい。質問は聞き逃せない。
currentManifest.duration_note: numeric design hypotheses; human natural failure and cognitive timing unmeasured; five minutes of meeting time equals sixty real simulation seconds
currentManifest.primary_score: 10 points per real SIDE WORK second; prospective20 in board mode; LISTEN earns0
currentManifest.secondary_score: questions answered and real side-work seconds
currentManifest.escalation_mechanic: Once at300 virtual meeting seconds, freeze and offer free score banking or board mode with more questions, readable cues and future work points2x.
currentManifest.risk_reward: LISTEN is always safe but earns0. Work earns points but a genuine question while working ends the run. Board choice resumes listening without changing prior points or cue time.
currentManifest.visual_identity: generated boss talk/glance/question and colleagues in a code conference room at eye level, visible typing foreground and live dialogue
